items.titleZh: 加斯利赛后发文：今天很痛苦，全队将向前看
items.summaryZh: 加斯利在X上发文称今天的结果很痛苦，车队将向前看，争取在马来西亚站拿到积分。
items.originalTitle: Painful one today. We will move on as a team on scoring points in malaysia
items.summaryEn: Painful one today. We will move on as a team on scoring points in malaysia
detailZh: 今天非常痛苦。我们将作为一个团队向前看，去争取在马来西亚站拿到积分。——皮埃尔·加斯利
detailEn: Painful one today. We will move on as a team on scoring points in malaysia
keyPointsZh: 加斯利表示车队将以整体的方式继续前进，目标是下站在马来西亚拿下积分。
keyPointsEn: Gasly said the team will move on together with the goal of scoring points in Malaysia.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘发文：比赛表现强势，红牛车队收获双领奖台
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在X上发帖表示比赛非常接近，车队比赛表现十分强势，最终为红牛取得了一个出色的团队结果——双领奖台。

media.altZh: 维斯塔潘发文：比赛表现强势，红牛车队收获双领奖台

items.originalTitle: So close!! We had a very strong race and in the end a great team result with a double podium @redbullracing 💪💪
items.summaryEn: So close!! We had a very strong race and in the end a great team result with a double podium @redbullracing 💪💪
detailZh: “So close!! We had a very strong race and in the end a great team result with a double podium @redbullracing 💪💪”——马克斯·维斯塔潘
detailEn: So close!! We had a very strong race and in the end a great team result with a double podium @redbullracing 💪💪
keyPointsZh: 维斯塔潘赛后第一时间在个人X账号上发文，用“非常接近”形容比赛结果。
keyPointsEn: Verstappen posted on his personal X account right after the race, describing the result as very close.

items.titleZh: 赛恩斯巴库收官拿分：升级是进步信号，盼中游能更有乐趣
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车手卡洛斯·赛恩斯在阿塞拜疆大奖赛后发文：「很高兴在昨天受罚之后还能拿分，车队应得这一分。安全车重启后做得不错。我们的升级是进步的信号：要经常得分还需要更多时间，但希望我们在中游能多一点乐趣！」（来源：X @Carlossainz55）

media.altZh: 赛恩斯巴库收官拿分：升级是进步信号，盼中游能更有乐趣

items.originalTitle: Happy to get a point after yesterday’s penalty. The team deserved it.
detailZh: 🇦🇿 很高兴在昨天受罚之后还能拿分，车队应得这一分。安全车重启后做得不错。我们的升级是进步的信号：要经常得分还需要更多时间，但希望我们在中游能多一点乐趣！
detailEn: 🇦🇿 Happy to get a point after yesterday’s penalty. The team deserved it. Good restart after the SC. Our upgrades are a sign of progress: it’ll take more time to get in the points regularly, but hopefully we’ll have a bit more fun in the midfield!
keyPointsZh: 赛恩斯赛后英文帖：罚退仍拿分
自评升级有进展，中游得分仍需时间
另有同内容西语帖，本条取英文原文

items.titleZh: 奥康巴库第八：「不瞒你们，这分因很多理由特别爽」
items.summaryZh: 哈斯车手埃斯特班·奥康在阿塞拜疆大奖赛赛后发文：「第八！！不瞒你们，这分因为很多不同的理由特别爽。我们应得这个结果。车子状态不错，把这股势头保持到接下来几站！」（来源：X @OconEsteban）

media.altZh: 奥康巴库第八：「不瞒你们，这分因很多理由特别爽」

items.originalTitle: P8 !! not gonna lie, this one feels good for many different reasons.
detailZh: 第八！！不瞒你们，这分因为很多不同的理由特别爽。我们应得这个结果。车子状态不错，把这股势头保持到接下来几站！
detailEn: P8 !! not gonna lie, this one feels good for many different reasons. we deserve this result. the car is working well, let’s keep this momentum going into the next ones!
keyPointsZh: 奥康赛后亲发：巴库收官P8
称车感良好，要把势头带进下一站
配多张围场/领奖庆祝图

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔巴库夺冠达成大满贯 发文感谢车队与车迷
items.summaryZh: 拉塞尔在社交平台发帖庆祝自己在巴库夺得杆位起跑至胜利的大满贯，并表示时隔已久再次站上最高领奖台、重现T字庆祝姿势。

media.altZh: 拉塞尔巴库夺冠达成大满贯 发文感谢车队与车迷

items.originalTitle: P1 in Baku and a grand slam!! 🏆🇦🇿 Feels great to be back on the top step of the podium. It’s been a while since the T-pose has made an appea...
items.summaryEn:
P1 in Baku and a grand slam!! 🏆🇦🇿 Feels great to be back on the top step of the podium. It’s been a while since the T-pose has made an appearance 😂 
Solid work from the team and thanks to the fans for the love. Feeling energised for the upcoming races. Let’s go, team 👊
detailZh: 拉塞尔在帖子中写道：“巴库第一，还有大满贯！！🏆🇦🇿 能重新站上最高领奖台感觉真好。T字姿势好久没亮相了😂 车队干得漂亮，也感谢车迷们的厚爱。对接下来的比赛充满能量。继续冲，车队👊”
detailEn:
P1 in Baku and a grand slam!! 🏆🇦🇿 Feels great to be back on the top step of the podium. It’s been a while since the T-pose has made an appearance 😂 
Solid work from the team and thanks to the fans for the love. Feeling energised for the upcoming races. Let’s go, team 👊
keyPointsZh: 拉塞尔赛后发文称重返最高领奖台感觉很好，并感谢车队的努力工作和车迷的支持。
他表示对即将到来的比赛充满干劲，并号召车队继续前进。
keyPointsEn: Russell said in his post that it felt great to be back on the top step of the podium, thanking the team for their solid work and the fans for their love.
He added that he feels energised for the upcoming races and encouraged the team to keep going.

items.titleZh: 赛恩斯：阿塞拜疆站感觉向前迈进一步，车队离中游更近
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车手卡洛斯·赛恩斯在阿塞拜疆站周四练习结束后发文表示，今天感觉向前迈了一步，虽然没能跑完所有圈数来全面评估，但自己感觉更好了，车队看起来离中游更近了一点。
items.originalTitle: Today felt like a step forward. We didn't get all the laps in to evaluate everything, but we still have FP3.
keyPointsZh: 他称自己在车里感觉更好，认为车队离中游更近了一点
他表示还有第三次练习赛可用来评估，目标是做出正确的调整
他用西班牙语发布了内容相同的帖子
keyPointsEn: He said he feels better in the car and believes the team is a bit closer to the midfield
He noted there is still FP3 to evaluate everything and that the aim is to make the right adjustments for tomorrow
He posted the same message in Spanish

items.titleZh: 赛恩斯发布自制纪录片：回顾马德里主场特别一周
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车手卡洛斯·赛恩斯在个人YouTube频道更新自制系列《DONTBLINK》第七季第三集，以第一人称影像回顾马德里主场站前后一周的生活。
items.originalTitle: One very special week in Madrid 🇪🇸 I | DONTBLINK EP3 SEASON 7 by Carlos Sainz
items.summaryEn: Williams driver Carlos Sainz has released the third episode of Season 7 of his self-produced YouTube series DONTBLINK, using first-person footage to look back on his week around his home race in Madrid.
keyPointsZh: 本集内容紧贴上一站周末，属于车手自制的生活/赛周纪录片向内容。
keyPointsEn: The episode follows directly on from the previous race weekend and is self-produced documentary-style content covering the race week.
